title: Piranhas Can't Bite Through This Fish. Its Scales Are Layered Armor

scenes.text: Piranhas swim with a fish they can't bite through.
It's the arapaima, a giant Amazon fish.
Its scales are only as thick as a grain of rice.
A hard mineral layer outside, and a soft, tough collagen layer inside.
If a bite gets through, the scale bends instead of breaking.
Engineers now study it to design better body armor.

description:
Piranhas swim with a fish they can't bite through.
Arapaima scales have a hard outer layer and a tough collagen layer, and engineers at UC San Diego study them for new armor.
Would you wear armor inspired by a fish?
first_comment: Would you wear armor made like fish scales?
